class PasswordStrength
  COMMON = %w[password 123456 qwerty letmein].freeze

  def self.score(password)
    return 0 if password.blank? || COMMON.include?(password.downcase)

    score = [password.length / 4, 3].min
    score += 1 if password.match?(/[A-Z]/) && password.match?(/[a-z]/)
    score += 1 if password.match?(/\d/)
    [score, 4].min
  end
end
